analysis: The PR changes only docs/reference/protocol-messages.md. Head lines 757-765 add a paragraph on streamed `auto` tool calls. Fragments in `choices[].delta.tool_calls` share an `index`. The first fragment carries `id`, `type`, `function.name` and empty `function.arguments`. Later fragments carry `function.arguments` pieces. Consumers concatenate the pieces by `index`. The paragraph cites `MLXOpenAIService.swift` `streamChatCompletionFrames` and an architecture doc anchor, neither of which was supplied. I examined the supplied base text (the two units cover lines 1-583 of the base file) and the patch. No code, crypto, authorization, attestation, key custody or protocol validation behavior changes. The addition describes an existing chunk payload shape. It does not touch the encrypted-chunk fields (`data` empty when E2E is active, `encrypted_data`), so T-008 fail-closed encryption is unaffected. No relevant threat boundary in TB-002 or TB-011 changes, nor do assets A-001, A-003 or A-016. Prefix-cache threat T-041 is not affected. Open questions for later passes: whether the cited Swift source actually emits this streaming tool-call shape, and whether the new streaming path preserves chunk encryption and the forced-tool constraints. Those are outside the supplied evidence. This PR's docs-only change gives no basis for a finding.
